scenario.title: K1, a retry of the session grant: a file change answered acceptForSession, then a change to the same file in the next turn, and one after a resume if that did not ask (C21)
scenario.successCondition: Whether a second change to the same file asks in the next turn, and after the process was closed and the thread resumed

toolPermissions.policy: an approval request for what the prompt dictated — a command that holds the prompt's own and no other, in a scratch folder, or a file change whose paths are all in scratch folders — is answered as the scenario says; any other is declined, and a request for more permissions is granted nothing
